text:
maya: CI turned red on my feature branch after I rebased onto main, snapshot tests failing for 2 files. not sure what changed, pinging here for quick help :cry:
ci-bot: build #8421 — feature/siamese-snapshot — FAILED (tests: snapshot) <https://ci.redwood.dev/build/8421|details>
raj: which tests exactly? paste failing assertion lines if you can
maya: failing: tests/renderers/test_toolbar_snapshot.py::test_toolbar_render and tests/editor/test_canvas_snapshot.py::test_canvas_scale
maya: local run gives this output for the toolbar one:

```
assert snapshot == golden
E diff: - expected icon padding 8px
+ got 6px
```

maya: i rebased main and fixed a couple imports, nothing touches CSS AFAICT
jordan: did you rebase or merge main? merge can sometimes pull in updated snapshots in tree
maya: rebase. i also ran `yarn build` but skipped `yarn update:snapshots` intentionally
raj: quick triage: try pulling main snapshots and running only those two tests locally. `git checkout origin/main -- tests/__snapshots__` then run pytest -k toolbar_snapshot -q
alice: or bisect if you suspect a commit introduced a subtle change. i can run a bisect against main if you want
maya: would appreciate that. i have a busy afternoon
sam: i can kick off a bisect job — simple script:

```
git checkout feature/siamese-snapshot
git bisect start HEAD origin/main
git bisect run ./ci/check-snapshots.sh
```

sam: will run on a runner and report back (may take ~30m)
ci-bot: retrigger requested by sam — queued job #8422
jordan: also check if any upstream model formatting changed (canvas scale tweak) — editor snapshots often break when raster sizes change
raj: if bisect points to a main commit, we can update snapshots in main and then rebase you on top; if it points to your branch, fix and open a follow-up
sam: bisect started, first pass... :hourglass_flowing_sand:
maya: thanks team, if someone finds the culprit i can open a PR to update snapshots or revert the change on my branch
sam: bisect found first bad commit: abc1234 (main) — it adjusted devicePixelRatio handling in editor rendering
sam: conclusion: upstream change to canvas scaling. recommendation: update the golden images and include a short note in the commit message; i'm opening a quick PR to update snapshots in main
maya: perfect, i'll rebase once that's merged and run the full test matrix
alice: :thumbsup: good teamwork — marking this as handoff resolved for now
maya: closing the loop — PR merged and my branch green after rebase. thanks all!
